capabilities.label: Insumos (Cloudflare Worker)
capabilities.notes: API Cloudflare em https://api.skincos.com.br/insumos (proxy same-origin: /api/insumos/* via CRM API).

capabilities.label: Messaging WhatsApp Engine
capabilities.notes: Runtime nativo único em /opt/skincos; API local na porta 8080 e compatibilidade multi-canal no CRM.

capabilities.label: Harmonia (WhatsApp Leads)
capabilities.notes: Decision + executor interno. Webhooks: POST /api/harmonia/webhook/official e /webhook/evolution. Endpoint principal: POST /api/harmonia/ingest

capabilities.label: Agent Zero
capabilities.notes: Entrypoint: backend/scripts/dev.sh agent. Canonical: backend/apps/agent-zero/ (UI/API integrada em backend/apps/agent-zero/integrated/).

capabilities.label: Sales Chart Messenger
capabilities.notes: Automação Google Sheets/Drive -> WhatsApp. Entrypoint: backend/scripts/dev.sh sales-chart-messenger ou backend/apps/automations/sales_chart_messenger/scripts/run.sh

capabilities.label: Instagram Module
capabilities.notes: Config em config.local.json (ignorado) e API Node em instagram_api_server.js (porta default 3103 para evitar conflito com WhatsApp instances).
